name: Venerable Warsinger

abilities.text: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, you may return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of damage ~ dealt to that player.

notes: X is the trigger's own amount (that-many = the combat damage this creature dealt to that player), used as the mvLE of the graveyard target.

issues: return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of damage this creature dealt to that player — expected X = the combat damage just dealt (e.g. 3), so a mana-value-2 creature card is a legal target — scripted filter mvLE:{count:'that-many'} — target legality runs matchesFilter -> characteristics.ts:274, which calls evalAmount(..., source) with NO AmountCtx, and 'that-many' falls back to `ctx?.thatMany ?? ctx?.refs?.item.lastAmount ?? 0` (characteristics.ts:170) = 0. Only mana-value-0 creature cards can ever be targeted. Blind run confirms: Grizzly Bears (MV 2) stayed in the graveyard after 3 damage. — CR 608.2b, 601.2c

you may return TARGET creature card ... — expected the target is chosen when the trigger goes on the stack; the 'may' is decided on resolution — scripted the targeted return-from-graveyard is nested inside {op:'may'} — acceptable ordering in this engine, but it mixes the optional decision with target selection; moot while the mvLE defect stands. — CR 601.2c, 603.3d
Vigilance, trample — expected two keywords — scripted keywords:['vigilance','trample'] with a covers entry — correct. — CR 702.20b, 702.19b

you may return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of damage this creature dealt to that player — expected X = the combat damage just dealt (e.g. 3), so a mana-value-2 creature card is a legal target. — scripted mvLE:{count:'that-many'} sits inside the TARGET filter. Target legality goes legal.ts -> matchesFilter -> characteristics.ts:274, which calls evalAmount(..., source) with NO AmountCtx, and 'that-many' falls through to `ctx?.thatMany ?? ctx?.refs?.item.lastAmount ?? 0` (characteristics.ts:170) = 0. Only mana-value-0 creature cards are ever legal targets. Blind scenario confirms Grizzly Bears (MV 2) is not returned after 3 damage. — CR CR 608.2b, 601.2c

you may return TARGET creature card — expected The target is chosen when the trigger is put on the stack; the 'may' is decided on resolution. — scripted 'may' wraps return-from-graveyard with target:true — ordering is tolerable in this engine, but moot given the mvLE=0 defect.
Vigilance, trample — expected Both keywords. — scripted keywords ['vigilance','trample'] with a covers entry. Correct.
